encoder.centering: raw(history) - raw(zeros_like(history)); mu retained in both
encoder.deployment_use: once at t=0.1 s; no future observations or latent resets

coordinates.q_unit: latent storage coordinate; numerical coefficient of q^2/2 is 1
coordinates.H_unit: formal model storage; SI joule calibration is not asserted

physics_unit_convention.mass: p * s^2 / rad, from inertia / omega_s

coordinates.mu: log of numerical [mass, max(damping,1e-8), rate, gain] in source units

function_inputs.edge_exchange: [sin difference, cos difference, local_i..., local_j..., mu_i..., mu_j...]
function_inputs.edge_dissipation: [sin difference, cos difference, local_i..., local_j..., mu_i..., mu_j...]

coordinates.coefficient_convention: F_o(v)=sum_a coefficients[a,o]*product_d v[d]**powers[a,d]; coefficients use the declared numerical coordinates and outer equations

structure.centering: F(v)-F(0)-gradient(F)(0) dot v; physical mu is held fixed
structure.edge_symmetry: average F([sin_diff,cos_diff,s_i,s_j,mu_i,mu_j]) and F([-sin_diff,cos_diff,s_j,s_i,mu_j,mu_i]) before centering in [eta,s_i,s_j]
structure.exchange: node skew pair matrix; edge K=strength/2*(F(forward)-F(reverse)^T)
structure.ports: two fixed directions pi,p; learned F(local,mu)-F(0,mu); fixed +p in pi_dot and -gain*omega in p_dot
structure.claims: power construction only; no automatic Poisson, global stability, accuracy, speed, or region certificate
